notes.title: Early Access Patch #1
notes.notes:
Early Access Patch #1 - 22nd November 2024

*Made a grab ring highlighter to show where to grab weapons when at the Vendor
*Made movement speed faster
*Improved Snap turning
*Made Snap turning faster
*Made Smooth Turning faster
*Made the overall Player faster at moving around
*Removed the big flash of light when any of the gates explode.
*Made the Weapon grab area bigger and easier to grab
*Fixed launch issues.
*Fixed audio issue on Level 6
*Fixed the strange pixel spots that show up in the dark shadowy areas




More Patches to come in the near future and some overhauls.

Coming in the next patch:

Sometimes when the player has the staff/magic Sceptre and they fall into the water and die and respawn the staff/magic Sceptre disappears and gets lost. This will be fixed in the next patch. The enemies will also have some tweaks done to them.

notes.title: Patch Note - Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixes made:

Ziplines should now reset to their start position if you fall off or you die.
Weapon Vendor in Level 1 now has  Text appear explaining more about the weapon

notes.title: Release Day is coming!
notes.notes: As a solo developer, I'm thrilled to announce the release of my debut game, 'The Journey into the Virtual Void,' on July 31, 2024, at 4 PM BST. The game will launch in Early Access for about a year, during which I will continually add new features, make improvements, and eagerly listen to your feedback. While I’m relatively new to game development—I started learning to code during the second lockdown in 2021—my goal is to create a short, enjoyable game inspired by my favorite retro games from childhood. Thank you for joining me on this exciting journey! ːsteamhappyː
